traits.name: Golden Luck
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The gold dragon fails a saving throw. Effect The dragon improves its result by one degree of success, turning a failure into a success or a critical failure into a normal failure. The dragon can't use this ability again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text:
⬺ The gold dragon breathes in one of two ways. The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.
  • Flame (arcane, evocation, fire); The dragon breathes a blast of flame in a 40-foot cone that deals 15d6 (15d6) fire damage (DC 37 basic Reflex save).
  • Weakening Gas (arcane, necromancy); The dragon breathes a blast of weakening gas. Each creature within a 40-foot cone must succeed at a DC 37 Fortitude save or become enfeebled 2 for 1 minute (or enfeebled 3 on a critical failure).

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The gold dragon makes two claw Strikes and one horns Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: When the gold dragon scores a critical hit with a Strike, it recharges Breath Weapon.
